original_test_intent: Verify BMC-local DRAM remains stable for more than 12 hours under U-Boot dramtest 0 at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails, and that normal BMC firmware/services recover afterward.
original_method: Identify the exact BMC and approved serial/debug console; preserve current firmware, boot variables and logs; enter U-Boot through a supported path, confirm vendor-specific dramtest 0 semantics/address coverage and non-destructive behavior, establish controlled 40C/-5% rails, run longer than 12 hours with console capture and independent BMC/rail supervision, then exit or reset through the approved recovery path and verify firmware boot, management network, sensors and logs at nominal conditions.
manual_activity: Operator accesses the BMC console, controls chamber/rails, supervises the long U-Boot run and restores normal firmware.
required_inputs: Approved U-Boot build and dramtest 0 syntax/coverage/return behavior
Exit/reset, boot-variable, network/service and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not run an unverified bootloader memory command
Preserve boot environment and console transcript
Maintain independent recovery and power-control path
Abort on console loss, rail instability, repeated memory errors or thermal limit
Restore nominal rails before returning to service
agent_execution_scope: May inspect approved command semantics and analyze console/service artifacts
Must not enter bootloader, alter boot state or operate lab controls
engineer_actions: Validate restored BMC and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies manual execution; the literal command still needs platform-specific semantics and memory-range safety confirmation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use dramtest 0 only on the approved BMC/U-Boot build with documented range and return path under direct console supervision.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC U-Boot, dramtest 0, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and more than 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record an uninterrupted console transcript synchronized to rail/environment telemetry and follow with explicit BMC service recovery checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds command-range validation, boot-state preservation, independent abort and measurable normal-operation recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host memory stress or a successful reboot cannot prove BMC-local DRAM coverage during the low-rail interval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A bootloader DRAM test may overwrite reserved memory or never return; console loss alone is not distinguishable from a BMC hang without independent observation.

project_override_considerations: BMC owner must define dramtest 0 implementation, safe address coverage, expected progress/error output and the supported path back to production firmware.
expected_evidence: BMC/firmware/U-Boot identity and preserved boot environment
Approved dramtest help/spec and console route
Continuous >12-hour console transcript with progress/error status
Reset/exit sequence and production firmware boot
Management network, Redfish/IPMI, sensor, SEL and event-log post-health

review_improvement: Distinguishes BMC-local memory coverage from host memory and makes a potentially non-returning bootloader command recoverable and auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: U-Boot DRAM test implementations differ in address selection and return behavior. A long run that stops printing could be a completed loop, console failure or BMC hang. The review therefore requires vendor semantics, continuous console evidence and independent service recovery checks after nominal restoration.
